intent: Make every important portal visual understandable, explorable and actionable without inventing evidence.
learned: A chart is incomplete until the user can understand what changed, why it matters and what action follows.
Forecast UX must expose assumptions, horizon and uncertainty; false precision is forbidden.
The safest first forecast layer derives only from already-visible portal values and trends.
The same interaction contract should enhance KPI cards, strategic visuals and decision surfaces instead of creating isolated widgets.
